<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-Hant">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>四維自學冒險地圖</title>
<meta name="description" content="花蓮縣私立四維高級中學 圖書資訊中心｜自主學習冒險地圖：選一位 SWSH 夥伴，走遍地圖完成自主學習的每一關。">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Huninn&family=Noto+Sans+TC:wght@400;700;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<!-- 角色插畫 © Ming chi｜SWSH 校園 IP -->
<style>
  :root {
    color-scheme: light;
    --green: #5BB334; --green-dark: #3F8A22; --green-ink: #166534; --green-soft: #F0FDF4; --green-line: #BBF7D0;
    --ink: #2D3748; --muted: #64748B; --paper: #FFFDF6; --card: #ffffff;
    --yellow: #F59E0B; --pink: #DB2777; --blue: #2563EB; --purple: #7C3AED;
    --round: 'Huninn', 'Noto Sans TC', 'PingFang TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', sans-serif;
    --sans: 'Noto Sans TC', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', sans-serif;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  body {
    margin: 0; font-family: var(--sans); color: var(--ink); line-height: 1.65;
    background-color: var(--paper);
    background-image: linear-gradient(#EEF5E6 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, #EEF5E6 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: 22px 22px;
  }
  a { color: inherit; }
  button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
  .wrap { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 16px 16px 40px; }
  .round { font-family: var(--round); }
  .visually-hidden { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }

  /* ---------- 標題列 ---------- */
  .masthead { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin: 6px 0 14px; }
  .masthead h1 { font-family: var(--round); font-size: clamp(24px, 4.2vw, 36px); color: var(--green-ink); margin: 0; letter-spacing: 1px; line-height: 1.25; }
  .masthead h1 small { display: block; font-size: 14px; color: #B45309; letter-spacing: 0; font-family: var(--sans); font-weight: 700; }
  .tape { display: inline-block; background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #FDE68A 0 8px, #FEF3C7 8px 16px); color: #854D0E; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 900; padding: 4px 14px; transform: rotate(-2deg); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.08); }

  /* ---------- 選角畫面 ---------- */
  .select { background: var(--green); border-radius: 28px; padding: 10px; box-shadow: 0 8px 0 var(--green-dark), 0 14px 26px rgba(63,138,34,.25); margin-bottom: 24px; }
  .select-inner { background: #FFFEF7; border: 2px dashed #A7D98C; border-radius: 22px; padding: 24px 18px 26px; text-align: center; }
  .select h2 { font-family: var(--round); font-size: clamp(22px, 3.6vw, 30px); color: var(--green-ink); margin: 8px 0 4px; }
  .select p.lead { color: #475569; margin: 0 auto 20px; max-width: 620px; font-size: 15px; }
  .pill { display: inline-block; background: var(--green-ink); color: #fff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; padding: 3px 14px; border-radius: 999px; letter-spacing: 2px; }
  .chars { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 128px), 1fr)); gap: 14px; }
  @media (max-width: 600px) { .chars { gap: 10px; } .select-inner { padding: 20px 12px 22px; } .char { padding: 12px 6px; } .char img { width: 76px; height: 76px; } .char .nm { font-size: 18px; } .char .intro { font-size: 12.5px; min-height: 0; } .char .go { font-size: 12.5px; padding: 5px 12px; } }
  .char {
    --c: #ccc; --c-soft: #fff; --c-ink: #333;
    background: #fff; border: 3px solid var(--c); border-radius: 22px; padding: 16px 10px 14px; box-shadow: 0 6px 0 var(--c);
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; color: var(--c-ink);
    transition: transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease;
  }
  .char:hover, .char:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-4px) rotate(-1deg); box-shadow: 0 10px 0 var(--c); outline: none; }
  .char:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--c); }
  .char img { width: 96px; height: 96px; border-radius: 50%; border: 3px solid var(--c); background: #fff; object-fit: cover; }
  .char .nm { font-family: var(--round); font-size: 20px; margin-top: 4px; }
  .char .trait { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; background: var(--c-soft); padding: 1px 10px; border-radius: 999px; }
  .char .intro { font-size: 13px; color: #475569; min-height: 42px; margin: 6px 0 8px; }
  .char .go { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 900; color: #fff; background: var(--c-ink); padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 999px; }
  .char.is-current { outline: 4px solid var(--c-ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

  /* ---------- HUD ---------- */
  .hud { position: sticky; top: 8px; z-index: 30; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 10px 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.96); border: 2px solid var(--green-line); border-radius: 18px; padding: 8px 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.07); margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .hud .me { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  .hud .me img { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2.5px solid var(--c, #BBF7D0); object-fit: cover; background: #fff; }
  .hud .me b { font-family: var(--round); font-size: 17px; color: var(--green-ink); display: block; line-height: 1.2; }
  .hud .me span { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
  .stamps { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; align-items: center; flex: 1 1 260px; }
  .stamps .lbl { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--green-ink); margin-right: 4px; }
  .stamp { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 15px; background: #F1F5F9; border: 2px dashed #CBD5E1; filter: grayscale(1); opacity: .55; transition: all .3s; }
  .stamp.on { background: #FEF9C3; border: 2px solid #FACC15; filter: none; opacity: 1; transform: rotate(-8deg); }
  .hud-btns { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
  .btn-sm { border: 2px solid var(--green-line); background: #fff; color: var(--green-ink); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px; }
  .btn-sm:hover { background: var(--green-soft); }
  @media (max-width: 600px) {
    .hud { gap: 6px 10px; padding: 6px 10px; top: 4px; }
    .hud .me img { width: 36px; height: 36px; }
    .hud .me b { font-size: 15px; }
    .hud .me span { display: none; }
    .stamps { flex-basis: 100%; gap: 3px; }
    .stamp { width: 25px; height: 25px; font-size: 12px; }
    .hud-btns { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; }
    .btn-sm { padding: 3px 9px; font-size: 12px; }
  }

  /* ---------- 地圖 ---------- */
  .map-frame { background: #fff; padding: 10px; border-radius: 26px; box-shadow: 0 8px 0 #A7D98C, 0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.08); border: 3px solid var(--green); }
  .map-scroll { overflow-x: auto; border-radius: 18px; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
  .map { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1000 / 720; min-width: 700px; border-radius: 18px; overflow: hidden; background: #BFE6F5; }
  .map svg#map-svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
  .hint-swipe { display: none; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); text-align: center; margin: 6px 0 0; }
  @media (max-width: 740px) { .hint-swipe { display: block; } }

  .node { position: absolute; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; z-index: 5; color: var(--ink); }
  .node .bub { --nc: #5BB334; width: 66px; height: 66px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; border: 4px solid var(--nc); display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 32px; box-shadow: 0 5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.15); transition: transform .18s ease; position: relative; }
  .node:hover .bub, .node:focus-visible .bub { transform: scale(1.12) rotate(-4deg); }
  .node:focus-visible { outline: none; }
  .node:focus-visible .bub { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #fff, 0 0 0 7px var(--nc); }
  .node .lab { font-family: var(--round); font-size: 14px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); padding: 1px 10px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid var(--nc, #5BB334); white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.08); }
  .node .stg { position: absolute; top: -8px; right: -10px; background: var(--nc); color: #fff; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid #fff; line-height: 18px; font-family: var(--sans); }
  .node .chk { position: absolute; bottom: -6px; left: -8px; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; background: #FACC15; color: #713F12; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; display: none; place-items: center; border: 2px solid #fff; transform: rotate(-10deg); }
  .node.done .chk { display: grid; }
  .node.here .bub { animation: pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes pulse { 0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.15), 0 0 0 0 rgba(250,204,21,.7); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.15), 0 0 0 12px rgba(250,204,21,0); } }

  .token { position: absolute; z-index: 20; width: 58px; height: 58px; transform: translate(-50%, -128%); pointer-events: none; }
  .token img { width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; border: 3.5px solid #fff; background: #fff; object-fit: cover; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--tc, #5BB334), 0 8px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.25); animation: bob 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .token::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: -10px; margin-left: -8px; border: 8px solid transparent; border-top-color: var(--tc, #5BB334); }
  .token.walking img { animation: walk .28s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes bob { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-5px); } }
  @keyframes walk { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(-6deg); } 50% { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(6deg); } }

  .map svg.compass { position: absolute; left: 1.6%; top: 2.4%; width: 64px; height: 64px; z-index: 3; }
  .map-title { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 1.8%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 4; background: #FFFBEB; border: 2.5px solid #D97706; color: #92400E; font-family: var(--round); font-size: 15px; padding: 2px 18px; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #D97706; white-space: nowrap; }

  /* ---------- 快速傳送 ---------- */
  .quick { margin: 18px 0 0; }
  .quick h3 { font-family: var(--round); font-size: 18px; color: var(--green-ink); margin: 0 0 8px; }
  .quick-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 150px), 1fr)); gap: 8px; }
  .quick-list button { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #fff; border: 2px solid var(--qc, #BBF7D0); border-radius: 14px; padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); }
  .quick-list button:hover { background: var(--green-soft); }
  .quick-list .e { font-size: 22px; }
  .quick-list .s { margin-left: auto; font-size: 14px; }

  /* ---------- 對話視窗 ---------- */
  dialog.panel { width: min(680px, calc(100vw - 24px)); max-height: calc(100vh - 32px); padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 26px; background: transparent; overflow: visible; }
  dialog.panel::backdrop { background: rgba(22, 101, 52, .35); backdrop-filter: blur(2px); }
  .panel-card { background: #FFFEF7; border: 4px solid var(--pc, #5BB334); border-radius: 26px; box-shadow: 0 8px 0 var(--pc, #5BB334); max-height: calc(100vh - 44px); display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
  .panel-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 16px 12px; background: var(--ps, #F0FDF4); border-bottom: 2px dashed var(--pc, #5BB334); }
  .panel-head .e { font-size: 38px; line-height: 1; }
  .panel-head h2 { font-family: var(--round); font-size: 22px; margin: 0; color: var(--pi, #166534); line-height: 1.3; }
  .panel-head .tag { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--pi, #166534); letter-spacing: 1px; }
  .panel-head .x { margin-left: auto; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--pc); background: #fff; font-size: 18px; color: var(--pi); flex: 0 0 auto; }
  .panel-body { padding: 14px 18px 6px; overflow-y: auto; }
  .panel-foot { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 10px 16px 14px; border-top: 2px dashed #E2E8F0; background: #fff; }
  .say { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .say img { flex: 0 0 58px; width: 58px; height: 58px; border-radius: 50%; border: 3px solid var(--tc, #BBF7D0); object-fit: cover; background: #fff; }
  .say .bubble { position: relative; background: #fff; border: 2px solid var(--tc, #BBF7D0); border-radius: 16px; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 14.5px; color: var(--ink); }
  .say .bubble::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -8px; top: 20px; width: 12px; height: 12px; background: #fff; border-left: 2px solid var(--tc, #BBF7D0); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--tc, #BBF7D0); transform: rotate(45deg); }
  .say .bubble b { font-family: var(--round); color: var(--tci, #166534); }
  .panel-body p { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 14.5px; }
  .task { display: block; background: #F0FDF4; border: 2px dashed #86EFAC; border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #166534; margin: 4px 0 12px; }
  .task.y { background: #FFFBEB; border-color: #FCD34D; color: #92400E; }
  .task.b { background: #F0F9FF; border-color: #7DD3FC; color: #075985; }
  .task.p { background: #F5F3FF; border-color: #C4B5FD; color: #5B21B6; }
  .cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; text-decoration: none; background: var(--green); color: #fff; font-weight: 900; font-size: 15px; padding: 11px 22px; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--green-dark); border: 0; }
  .cta:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); }
  .cta.orange { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F59E0B, #D97706); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #B45309; }
  .cta.ghost { background: #fff; color: var(--green-ink); border: 2px solid var(--green-line); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--green-line); padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; }
  .cta.next { background: var(--pi, #166534); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.2); padding: 9px 18px; font-size: 14px; }
  .center { text-align: center; margin: 6px 0 12px; }
  .grid-links { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 140px), 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin: 0 0 14px; }
  .grid-links a { display: block; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; padding: 9px 6px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; border: 2px solid var(--lc, #E2E8F0); background: var(--lb, #F8FAFC); color: var(--li, #1E3A8A); }
  .grid-links a:hover { filter: brightness(.97); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .grid-links a small { font-weight: 400; font-size: 11px; }
  .cat { font-family: var(--round); font-size: 16px; margin: 4px 0 6px; }
  .legend { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr)); gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .legend a { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; text-decoration: none; border: 2.5px solid var(--lc); background: #fff; border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 12px; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--lc); }
  .legend .ic { flex: 0 0 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 12px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 24px; background: var(--lb); }
  .legend b { display: block; font-size: 15px; color: #0F172A; }
  .legend span { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); }
  .legend em { font-style: normal; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; color: #fff; background: var(--li); padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 6px; }
  .halls { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 130px), 1fr)); gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .halls a { display: block; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; background: #fff; border: 6px solid #D97706; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 6px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #FDE68A, 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.08); color: #1E293B; }
  .halls a span { display: block; font-size: 30px; line-height: 1.2; }
  .halls a b { display: block; font-size: 14.5px; }
  .halls a small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
  .info { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 190px), 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .info > * { background: #fff; border: 2px solid #FBCFE8; border-radius: 14px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; color: #475569; text-decoration: none; }
  .info b { color: #9D174D; }
  .howto { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 12px; display: grid; gap: 6px; }
  .howto li { background: #fff; border: 2px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 14px; }

  /* ---------- 完成慶祝 ---------- */
  .confetti { position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 100; overflow: hidden; }
  .confetti i { position: absolute; top: -20px; width: 10px; height: 14px; border-radius: 2px; animation: fall linear forwards; }
  @keyframes fall { to { transform: translateY(110vh) rotate(720deg); } }

  footer.foot { text-align: center; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 26px; }
  footer.foot a { color: var(--green-ink); }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
    html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">

  <header class="masthead">
    <div>
      <span class="tape">四維高中 圖書資訊中心・108 課綱彈性學習時間</span>
      <h1>四維自學冒險地圖 <small>⚔️ 選一位夥伴，走遍地圖，完成你的自主學習冒險！</small></h1>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- ===== 選角 ===== -->
  <section class="select" id="select" aria-labelledby="select-title">
    <div class="select-inner">
      <span class="pill">STEP 1</span>
      <h2 id="select-title">選擇你的冒險夥伴</h2>
      <p class="lead">自主學習是一場 <b>18 週的冒險</b>。選一位最像你的夥伴，他會陪你走遍地圖上的每一站，收集 8 枚印章！</p>
      <div class="chars" id="chars"></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ===== 地圖 ===== -->
  <section id="adventure" aria-labelledby="map-title" hidden>
    <h2 id="map-title" class="visually-hidden">冒險地圖</h2>
    <div class="hud" id="hud">
      <div class="me" id="me"><img id="me-img" src="" alt=""><div><b id="me-name"></b><span id="me-trait"></span></div></div>
      <div class="stamps" id="stamps" aria-label="印章收集進度"><span class="lbl" id="stamp-count">印章 0/8</span></div>
      <div class="hud-btns">
        <button class="btn-sm" id="btn-change" type="button">🔄 換夥伴</button>
        <button class="btn-sm" id="btn-reset" type="button">↺ 重新冒險</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="map-frame">
      <div class="map-scroll" id="map-scroll">
        <div class="map" id="map">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 1000 720" aria-hidden="true" id="map-svg">
            <defs>
              <pattern id="waves" width="60" height="30" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
                <path d="M5 18 q10 -10 20 0 t20 0" fill="none" stroke="#9AD3EC" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
              </pattern>
              <radialGradient id="land" cx="50%" cy="45%" r="60%">
                <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#E4F6CF"/>
                <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C6E8A6"/>
              </radialGradient>
            </defs>
            <rect width="1000" height="720" fill="#BFE6F5"/>
            <rect width="1000" height="720" fill="url(#waves)" opacity=".8"/>
            <!-- 沙灘 + 島 -->
            <path d="M120 112 C 220 30, 420 42, 520 72 C 640 22, 860 30, 935 132 C 1000 240, 972 380, 950 470 C 930 610, 830 702, 660 692 C 520 712, 380 700, 260 692 C 112 682, 30 610, 40 480 C 45 380, 18 300, 50 214 C 66 166, 84 136, 120 112 Z" fill="#F8E7B9"/>
            <path d="M130 128 C 225 55, 420 62, 520 92 C 640 45, 850 55, 915 145 C 975 245, 950 380, 930 465 C 910 590, 815 676, 660 668 C 520 688, 380 678, 262 670 C 126 660, 58 596, 64 482 C 68 382, 44 304, 74 224 C 88 178, 102 150, 130 128 Z" fill="url(#land)" stroke="#93C572" stroke-width="4"/>
            <!-- 池塘 -->
            <ellipse cx="715" cy="585" rx="70" ry="32" fill="#A5DBF0" stroke="#7CC3E0" stroke-width="3"/>
            <text x="700" y="592" font-size="20">🦆</text>
            <!-- 河流 -->
            <path d="M650 70 C 640 140, 690 190, 680 250 C 672 300, 700 340, 690 380" fill="none" stroke="#A5DBF0" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            <!-- 山 -->
            <g>
              <polygon points="690,250 760,120 830,250" fill="#9CC98A" stroke="#6FA85C" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

      <p>🏁 <b>GOAL！</b>你的作品，也可能成為下一屆學弟妹在靈感神殿裡看到的範例 ✨</p>`,
    sos: () => `
      <p>想主題卡住、不會填表、進度落後⋯⋯都可以來圖資中心找老師聊聊！</p>
      <div class="info">
        <div>🏫 <b>花蓮縣私立四維高級中學</b><br>圖書資訊中心</div>
        <div>📍 <b>地址</b><br>970 花蓮市中山路一段 200 號</div>
        <a href="tel:+88638561455">☎️ <b>電話（點我撥打）</b><br>(03) 856-1455 轉 517</a>
      </div>`
  };

  // ---------- 狀態 ----------
  const KEY = 'swsh-adventure-v1';
  let state = { char: null, at: 'start', stamps: [] };
  try { const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || 'null'); if (s && CHARS[s.char]) state = Object.assign(state, s); } catch (e) {}
  const save = () => { try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); } catch (e) {} };

  const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
  const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  // ---------- 選角卡 ----------
  const charsEl = $('#chars');
  Object.entries(CHARS).forEach(([id, c]) => {
    const b = document.createElement('button');
    b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'char'; b.dataset.id = id;
    b.style.setProperty('--c', c.c); b.style.setProperty('--c-soft', c.soft); b.style.setProperty('--c-ink', c.ink);
    b.innerHTML = `<img src="${IMG[id]}" alt=""><span class="nm">${c.name} ${c.emoji}</span><span class="trait">${c.trait}</span><span class="intro">「${c.intro}」</span><span class="go">選我出發 →</span>`;
    b.setAttribute('aria-label', `選擇 ${c.name}（${c.trait}）出發`);
    b.addEventListener('click', () => chooseChar(id));
    charsEl.appendChild(b);
  });

  // ---------- 道路 ----------
  const pt = id => byId[id];
  function smoothPath(points) {
    // Catmull-Rom 轉貝茲曲線
    let d = `M${points[0].x} ${points[0].y}`;
    for (let i = 0; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
      const p0 = points[i - 1] || points[i], p1 = points[i], p2 = points[i + 1], p3 = points[i + 2] || p2;
      const c1x = p1.x + (p2.x - p0.x) / 6, c1y = p1.y + (p2.y - p0.y) / 6;
      const c2x = p2.x - (p3.x - p1.x) / 6, c2y = p2.y - (p3.y - p1.y) / 6;
      d += ` C${c1x.toFixed(1)} ${c1y.toFixed(1)}, ${c2x.toFixed(1)} ${c2y.toFixed(1)}, ${p2.x} ${p2.y}`;
    }
    return d;
  }
  const roadPts = ROAD.map(pt);
  const roadD = smoothPath(roadPts);
  ['road-edge', 'road', 'road-dash'].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).setAttribute('d', roadD));
  const sosD = `M${pt('hall').x} ${pt('hall').y} Q ${(pt('hall').x + pt('sos').x) / 2} ${pt('sos').y + 40}, ${pt('sos').x} ${pt('sos').y}`;
  document.getElementById('sos-trail').setAttribute('d', sosD);

  // 每一段道路各做一條隱藏路徑，供角色沿路行走
  const svgNS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  const svg = $('#map-svg');
  const segs = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < roadPts.length - 1; i++) {
    const p = document.createElementNS(svgNS, 'path');
    // 與整條道路相同的曲線控制點
    const p0 = roadPts[i - 1] || roadPts[i], p1 = roadPts[i], p2 = roadPts[i + 1], p3 = roadPts[i + 2] || p2;
    const c1x = p1.x + (p2.x - p0.x) / 6, c1y = p1.y + (p2.y - p0.y) / 6;
    const c2x = p2.x - (p3.x - p1.x) / 6, c2y = p2.y - (p3.y - p1.y) / 6;
    p.setAttribute('d', `M${p1.x} ${p1.y} C${c1x} ${c1y}, ${c2x} ${c2y}, ${p2.x} ${p2.y}`);
    p.setAttribute('fill', 'none'); p.setAttribute('stroke', 'none');
    svg.appendChild(p); segs.push(p);
  }
  const sosPath = document.createElementNS(svgNS, 'path');
  sosPath.setAttribute('d', sosD); sosPath.setAttribute('fill', 'none'); sosPath.setAttribute('stroke', 'none');
  svg.appendChild(sosPath);

  // ---------- 地點按鈕 ----------
  const map = $('#map');
  const nodeEls = {};
  LOCS.forEach(l => {
    const b = document.createElement('button');
    b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'node';
    b.style.left = (l.x / 10) + '%'; b.style.top = (l.y / 7.2) + '%';
    b.innerHTML = `<span class="bub" style="--nc:${l.c}">${l.emoji}${l.stage ? `<span class="stg">${l.stage}</span>` : ''}<span class="chk" aria-hidden="true">✓</span></span><span class="lab" style="--nc:${l.c}">${l.name}</span>`;
    b.setAttribute('aria-label', `${l.name}（${l.tag}）`);
    b.addEventListener('click', () => travelTo(l.id));
    map.appendChild(b); nodeEls[l.id] = b;
  });

  // ---------- 快速傳送 & 印章 ----------
  const quick = $('#quick');
  const stampsEl = $('#stamps');
  const stampEls = {};
  LOCS.forEach(l => {
    const q = document.createElement('button');
    q.type = 'button'; q.style.setProperty('--qc', l.c + '66');
    q.innerHTML = `<span class="e">${l.emoji}</span><span>${l.name}${l.stage ? `<br><small style="color:${l.i};font-weight:700">STAGE ${l.stage}</small>` : ''}</span><span class="s" data-s="${l.id}"></span>`;
    q.addEventListener('click', () => { travelTo(l.id); $('#adventure').scrollIntoView({ behavior: reduceMotion ? 'auto' : 'smooth', block: 'start' }); });
    quick.appendChild(q);
    const s = document.createElement('span');
    s.className = 'stamp'; s.textContent = l.emoji; s.title = l.name;
    stampsEl.appendChild(s); stampEls[l.id] = s;
  });

  function renderStamps() {
    LOCS.forEach(l => {
      const on = state.stamps.includes(l.id);
      stampEls[l.id].classList.toggle('on', on);
      nodeEls[l.id].classList.toggle('done', on);
      const q = quick.querySelector(`[data-s="${l.id}"]`); if (q) q.textContent = on ? '✅' : '';
    });
    $('#stamp-count').textContent = `印章 ${state.stamps.length}/${LOCS.length}`;
  }

  // ---------- 角色 token ----------
  const token = $('#token');
  const scroller = $('#map-scroll');
  function placeToken(x, y, follow) {
    token.style.left = (x / 10) + '%'; token.style.top = (y / 7.2) + '%';
    if (follow !== false && scroller.scrollWidth > scroller.clientWidth + 4) {
      scroller.scrollLeft = (x / 1000) * map.clientWidth - scroller.clientWidth / 2;
    }
  }
  function markHere(id) { Object.values(nodeEls).forEach(n => n.classList.remove('here')); if (nodeEls[id]) nodeEls[id].classList.add('here'); }

  function animateAlong(path, reverse, ms) {
    return new Promise(res => {
      const len = path.getTotalLength();
      if (reduceMotion) { const p = path.getPointAtLength(reverse ? 0 : len); placeToken(p.x, p.y); return res(); }
      const t0 = performance.now();
      const step = now => {
        let t = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / ms);
        const e = t < .5 ? 2 * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 2) / 2;
        const p = path.getPointAtLength(len * (reverse ? 1 - e : e));
        placeToken(p.x, p.y);
        t < 1 ? requestAnimationFrame(step) : res();
      };
      requestAnimationFrame(step);
    });
  }

  let busy = false;
  async function travelTo(dest) {
    if (busy) return;
    if (!state.char) { $('#select').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }); return; }
    busy = true; token.classList.add('walking');
    let from = state.at;
    // 從救援站出發：先沿小徑回到靈感神殿
    if (from === 'sos' && dest !== 'sos') { await animateAlong(sosPath, true, 700); from = 'hall'; }
    if (dest === 'sos') {
      if (from !== 'sos') {
        await walkRoad(from, 'hall');
        await animateAlong(sosPath, false, 700);
      }
    } else {
      await walkRoad(from, dest);
    }
    token.classList.remove('walking'); busy = false;
    state.at = dest; save(); markHere(dest);
    openPanel(dest);
  }
  async function walkRoad(from, to) {
    let a = ROAD.indexOf(from), b = ROAD.indexOf(to);
    if (a < 0 || b < 0 || a === b) return;
    const dir = b > a ? 1 : -1;
    const n = Math.abs(b - a);
    const ms = Math.max(380, 900 - n * 90);
    for (let i = a; i !== b; i += dir) {
      const seg = dir > 0 ? segs[i] : segs[i - 1];
      await animateAlong(seg, dir < 0, ms);
    }
  }

  // ---------- 對話視窗 ----------
  const panel = $('#panel');
  function openPanel(id) {
    const l = byId[id], c = CHARS[state.char];
    const card = $('#panel-card');
    card.style.setProperty('--pc', l.c); card.style.setProperty('--ps', l.s); card.style.setProperty('--pi', l.i);
    card.style.setProperty('--tc', c.c); card.style.setProperty('--tci', c.ink);
    $('#panel-emoji').textContent = l.emoji;
    $('#panel-tag').textContent = l.tag;
    $('#panel-title').textContent = l.name;
    $('#panel-body').innerHTML = `<div class="say"><img src="${IMG[state.char]}" alt="${c.name}"><div class="bubble"><b>${c.name}：</b>${LINES[state.char][id]}</div></div>` + CONTENT[id]();
    $('#panel-body').scrollTop = 0;

    const firstVisit = !state.stamps.includes(id);
    if (firstVisit) { state.stamps.push(id); save(); renderStamps(); }

    const ri = ROAD.indexOf(id);
    const next = ri >= 0 && ri < ROAD.length - 1 ? ROAD[ri + 1] : (id === 'sos' ? null : null);
    const foot = $('#panel-foot');
    foot.innerHTML = `<span style="font-size:13px;color:${l.i};font-weight:700">${firstVisit ? '🔖 獲得印章：' + l.name + '！' : '✅ 已蓋過印章'}</span>`;
    const btns = document.createElement('span');
    btns.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap';
    if (next) {
      const nb = document.createElement('button');
      nb.type = 'button'; nb.className = 'cta next'; nb.textContent = `前往 ${byId[next].emoji} ${byId[next].name} →`;
      nb.addEventListener('click', () => { closePanel(); setTimeout(() => travelTo(next), 120); });
      btns.appendChild(nb);
    } else {
      const cb = document.createElement('button');
      cb.type = 'button'; cb.className = 'cta ghost'; cb.textContent = '回到地圖';
      cb.addEventListener('click', closePanel);
      btns.appendChild(cb);
    }
    foot.appendChild(btns);

    if (typeof panel.showModal === 'function') { if (!panel.open) panel.showModal(); } else { panel.setAttribute('open', ''); }

    if (firstVisit && state.stamps.length === LOCS.length) setTimeout(celebrate, 400);
  }
  function closePanel() { if (panel.open) { panel.close ? panel.close() : panel.removeAttribute('open'); } }
  $('#panel-close').addEventListener('click', closePanel);
  panel.addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target === panel) closePanel(); });

  function celebrate() {
    const box = document.createElement('div'); box.className = 'confetti';
    const colors = ['#5BB334', '#FACC15', '#F472B6', '#60A5FA', '#A78BFA', '#F59E0B'];
    if (!reduceMotion) for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) {
      const p = document.createElement('i');
      p.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + 'vw'; p.style.background = colors[i % colors.length];
      p.style.animationDuration = (2.2 + Math.random() * 1.8) + 's'; p.style.animationDelay = (Math.random() * .6) + 's';
      box.appendChild(p);
    }
    document.body.appendChild(box); setTimeout(() => box.remove(), 5000);
    const c = CHARS[state.char];
    const body = $('#panel-body');
    const done = document.createElement('div');
    done.style.cssText = 'margin-top:8px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,#FEF9C3 0 12px,#FEF3C7 12px 24px);border:2.5px solid #FACC15;border-radius:18px;padding:14px;text-align:center';
    done.innerHTML = `<div class="round" style="font-size:22px;color:#854D0E">🎊 8 枚印章集滿！冒險地圖全破！</div><p style="margin:6px 0 10px;color:#92400E">${c.name}：「地圖逛完了，接下來換你在現實中出發囉！」</p><a class="cta" href="${FORM}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">⬇️ 下載申請表，開始真正的冒險</a>`;
    body.appendChild(done); done.scrollIntoView({ behavior: reduceMotion ? 'auto' : 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
  }

  // ---------- 選角與重設 ----------
  function applyChar() {
    const c = CHARS[state.char];
    $('#me-img').src = IMG[state.char]; $('#me-img').alt = c.name;
    $('#me').style.setProperty('--c', c.c);
    $('#me-name').textContent = `${c.name} ${c.emoji}`;
    $('#me-trait').textContent = `我的冒險夥伴・${c.trait}・${c.intro}`;
    $('#token-img').src = IMG[state.char]; $('#token-img').alt = c.name;
    token.style.setProperty('--tc', c.ink);
    token.hidden = false;
    charsEl.querySelectorAll('.char').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('is-current', b.dataset.id === state.char));
    $('#adventure').hidden = false;
    const p = byId[state.at] || byId.start; placeToken(p.x, p.y); markHere(p.id);
  }
  function chooseChar(id) {
    const first = !state.char;
    state.char = id; save(); applyChar(); renderStamps();
    $('#adventure').scrollIntoView({ behavior: reduceMotion ? 'auto' : 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    if (first || state.stamps.length === 0) setTimeout(() => openPanel(state.at), reduceMotion ? 0 : 600);
  }
  $('#btn-change').addEventListener('click', () => $('#select').scrollIntoView({ behavior: reduceMotion ? 'auto' : 'smooth' }));
  $('#btn-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (!confirm('要清除印章，從出發村重新開始嗎？')) return;
    state.stamps = []; state.at = 'start'; save(); renderStamps();
    const p = byId.start; placeToken(p.x, p.y); markHere('start');
  });

  if (state.char) { applyChar(); renderStamps(); }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
